## Library Loading

```{r}
#| message: false
library("here")
library("tidyverse")
# library("purrr") # it's already inside tidyverse
```

Data paths:

```{r}
data_dir <- here("data")
raw_dir <- here("data/_raw")
```

## Donor Metadata

a\) Read metadata and handle NA strings

```{r}
donor_metadata <- read.csv(str_c(raw_dir,"/donor_metadata.csv"),
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("NA", "N/A", "", "Unknown or N/A" ))
```

b\) mutate age col

```{r}
donor_metadata <-
donor_metadata |>
  mutate(age = map_dbl(.x = age, 
                   ~ str_split(.x, "[-+]",simplify = T) |>
                     # we look for ranges (-) or + (when more than 100y)
                     # and split into the two numbers
                     as.numeric() |> 
                     # we convert all values into numbers
                     mean(na.rm = T) |> 
                     # we take the mean. if there is only one val,
                     # or the other is NA (100+) => the single val is returned
                     floor() 
                     # in case the mean of a range returns a .5
                   )
         )
```

c\) filtering data (case-control, remove "black")

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| echo: false
donor_metadata |> 
  distinct(nincds_arda_diagnosis)
```

```{r}
donor_metadata <- donor_metadata |> 
  filter(nincds_arda_diagnosis != "Dementia, Type Unknown"
                                     & race != "black") 
```

d\) Creating needed columns

```{r}
donor_metadata <- donor_metadata |> 
  mutate(alzheimer=case_when(
    nincds_arda_diagnosis == "No Dementia" ~ "no",
    TRUE ~ "yes"
  ))
```

e\) Remove superfluous cols

```{r}
donor_metadata <- donor_metadata |> 
  select(-c(name, control_set, 
            ever_tbi_w_loc, race, 
            hispanic, nincds_arda_diagnosis
            )
         )
```

f\) Save cleaned df (moved after protein for filtering reasons)

## Protein Data

a\) Read protein data

```{r}
#| message: false
protein_df <- read_csv(here("data/_raw/prot_data.csv"))
```

b\) Drop superfluous cols and filter for structure and donors

```{r}
protein_clean_df <- protein_df |>
  select(-c(donor_name, structure_id), -starts_with("IHC")) |>
  filter(structure_acronym %in% c("HIP", "FWM")) |>
  filter(donor_id %in% (donor_metadata |> 
                          pull(donor_id))
         )
```

c\) Handling NAs in cols and rows

```{r}
protein_clean_df <-
protein_clean_df |> 
  filter(rowMeans(is.na(pick(everything())
                        )
                  ) <= 0.4) |>
  # removing rows with more than 40% NAs
  select(where( ~mean(is.na(.x)) <= 0.4))
  # removing cols with more than 40% NAs
```

e\) Save cleaned df

```{r}
write_csv(x = protein_clean_df,
          file = here("data/03_protein_data_clean.csv"))
```

Saving cleaned metadata after filtering (f)

```{r}
donor_metadata <- donor_metadata |>
  filter(donor_id %in% (protein_clean_df |>
                          distinct(donor_id) |>
                          pull(donor_id)
                        )
         )


metadata_file <- str_c(data_dir, "/03_donor_metadata_clean.csv")
write_csv(x = donor_metadata,
          file = metadata_file)
```

## RNA-Seq Data

a1) Read the RNA-seq data

```{r}
#| message: false
rnaseq_df <- read_csv(str_c(raw_dir, "/fpkm_table_normalized.csv.gz"))
```

a2) Read the gene data

```{r}
#| message: false
genes_df <- read_csv(str_c(raw_dir, "/rows-genes.csv"))
```

a3) Read the sample data

```{r}
#| message: false
samples_df <- read_csv(str_c(raw_dir, "/columns-samples.csv"))
```

b\) Transpose df and rename sample id col

```{r}
rnaseq_df <- rnaseq_df |>
  rename(gene_id = 1) |>
  # not necessary but easier than "gene_id\rnaseq_profile_id"
  column_to_rownames(var = "gene_id") |>
  # we indicate that this is the header
  t() |> 
  # we use to transpose because the data is too big for the pivot functions
  as_tibble(rownames = "rnaseq_profile_id") |>    
  # because it generates a matrix
  mutate(rnaseq_profile_id = as.numeric(rnaseq_profile_id))
```

c\) Rename gene cols

```{r}
names_map <- genes_df |>
  filter(!is.na(gene_symbol)) |>
  # we must remove NAs to avoid missing names
  mutate(gene_symbol = make.unique(gene_symbol, sep = "_")) |>
  # we should handle possible collisions (symbol:id being 1:N)
  pull(gene_id, name = gene_symbol)
  # we pull as a named vector

rnaseq_df <- rnaseq_df |>
  rename(any_of(names_map))
```

d-e) Add donor_id and structure acronym + Remove rnaseq id

```{r}
rnaseq_df <- rnaseq_df |> 
  inner_join(samples_df |>
               select(rnaseq_profile_id, donor_id, structure_acronym),
             by = join_by(rnaseq_profile_id)) |>
  select(-rnaseq_profile_id)
```

f\) Place the two added col in first position

```{r}
rnaseq_df <- rnaseq_df |> 
  relocate(donor_id, structure_acronym)
```

g\) Filtering for samples of interest

```{r}
rnaseq_df <- rnaseq_df |>
  inner_join(
    protein_clean_df |>
      select(donor_id, structure_acronym),
    by = join_by(donor_id, structure_acronym)
  )

```

h\) Save cleaned df
```{r}
write_csv(rnaseq_df, str_c(data_dir, "/03_rnaseq_data_clean.csv.gz"))
```
